post.title: Dynamic Programming Patterns: Solving the 0/1 Knapsack and LCS Series
post.subtitle: Master the 0/1 Knapsack, LCS, and Edit Distance DP patterns with full Java solutions.
post.brief: Dynamic Programming (DP) resolves complex optimization problems by breaking them down into overlapping subproblems, storing results to prevent redundant calculations. This guide introduces the core DP patterns and implements 0/1 Knapsack, LCS, and Edit Distance in Java.
